newsitem.title: USA: SCP Pool sees Q2 earnings hurt by weather.
newsitem.headline: SCP Pool sees Q2 earnings hurt by weather.

text.p: SCP Pool Corp said Friday it expects its second quarter earnings will not show significant improvement over a year ago as a result of unseasonably cool temperatures this spring.
The First Call consensus EPS estimate for the company's June second quarter is $1.59 per share versus $1.30 in 1996.
"Continued wet and rainy weather has also dampened sales and installations of pools," company chairman WB Sexton said in a press release.

"Assuming the presence of more seasonable weather conditions, we expect our growth to accelerate during the remainder of the summer and remain confident about reporting higher earnings for 1997 as a whole," Sexton said.
The First Call EPS projection for the year is $1.50 per share versus $1.05 for all of 1996.
